subject: CSA intake: telemetry artifact onboarding and control map deliverables
messages:
From: Natalie Greene <natalie@orchidhealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@orchidhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CSA intake: telemetry exports & control mapping request

Hi Sergio,

Hope you're well. We're kicking off the CSA (CAIQ) intake for our next internal review and need a compact deliverable set from Redwood to close out network, logging, and key management controls. Specifically we need: 

- A control-to-evidence crosswalk for CSA controls in scope (network, identity, logging, key mgmt).
- Sample telemetry exports (compressed logs) for a two-week window (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-14) with redaction guidance.
- A brief network diagram that highlights in-scope boundaries.
- Confirmation of rotation cadence for signing keys and HSM/KMS attestations.

Can you confirm owners, an ETA for an initial package, and whether Redwood can host artifacts on a read-only Drive link? We prefer the artifacts by 2026-11-12 to align with our audit window.

Thanks — if easier, a short walk-through call will suffice.

Best,
Natalie Greene
Director, IT Risk — Orchid Health

Attachment: none
From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: natalie@orchidhealth.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-07T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CSA intake: telemetry exports & control mapping request

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear list.

Quick ack: Redwood can provide a staged package that includes a control crosswalk (mapping CAIQ to our internal controls), a sanitized telemetry sample, and a network diagram. Owners below:

- Kimberly Park (Control mapping & evidence pack)
- Marissa Cole (Telemetry extracts & redaction)

We can host the artifacts in a read-only Drive folder and provide JIRA/HubSpot references for traceability. Targeting an initial drop by COB 2026-11-09 and a fuller package by 2026-11-12. Would you prefer the two-week sample you specified, or would a rolling 14-day window ending 2026-10-14 (i.e., 2026-10-01–10-14) be fine?

Also propose a 30-minute walkthrough on 2026-11-09 between 10:00–12:00 PT — let me know a preferred slot.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, natalie@orchidhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-08T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CSA intake: telemetry exports & control mapping request

Hi all — assigning ownership here and attaching the initial crosswalk.

Summary of deliverables (initial drop):
- redwood_control_map_initial.xlsx (attached) — a one-sheet mapping of CAIQ control IDs to Redwood evidence artifacts and where to find them (logs, runbooks, attestation docs).
- redwood_network_telemetry_sample.log.gz (attached) — a 48-hour compressed sample extracted from our centralized telemetry pipeline for schema verification; larger window to follow after alignment on redaction.
- evidence_manifest.md (will be in Drive) — manifest describing each artifact and its retention/collection method.

Redaction approach we propose:
- Replace usernames and IPs that correlate to customer data with consistent pseudonyms (e.g., user_###, ip_###).
- Preserve timestamps, event-types, and metadata needed for control verification.

Open items for Orchid:
1) Approval of the redaction approach above.
2) Confirmation that the requested 2026-10-01–2026-10-14 window is required; otherwise we can provide a narrower window to reduce scope.

I'll upload the full package to a read-only Drive folder once Natalie confirms redaction and window.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood_control_map_initial.xlsx (xlsx)
- redwood_network_telemetry_sample.log.gz (log.gz)
From: Natalie Greene <natalie@orchidhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, compliance@orchidhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-08T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CSA intake: telemetry exports & control mapping request

Thanks Kimberly — this looks like a good start. A couple of clarifications: 

- Redaction approach approved — please ensure pseudonymization is deterministic across files so we can correlate events.
- The full 2026-10-01–2026-10-14 window is preferred for sampling; if there are retention constraints, flag them and we'll accept a stratified sample (e.g., three 4-day slices).
- For keys/KMS evidence we need the last two rotation records and the policy doc describing rotation cadence. Can you include HSM attestation references if applicable?

Let's take the 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow 2026-11-09 at 10:30 PT. Please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Natalie
